name: Ritterorden
source:
Crystal stones, considered treasures of the Church, are instruments through which the power of God can be manifested.  These stones are lent by the Church to Ritterorden's many countries and nations in a claim for legitimacy and power. 

The great nation of Stiode is the recipient of one of these stones: the crystal stone of Shadow. These stones serve as emblems of order and authority in time of peace and as weapons of great power in times of strife.

On one side, are the holy knights who use these stones. On the other, a purple-haired girl who searches the world to destroy these stones. This story begins when the sides meet. 


[Lightly translated/adapted from [url=http://kimikakesou.sakura.ne.jp/topb.htm]developer site[/url].]
translation:
水晶石被认为是教会的瑰宝，是彰显上帝力量的工具。这些石头由教会借给里特罗登的许多国家和民族，以宣称其合法性和权力。

伟大的斯蒂奥德国家获得了其中一颗宝石：暗影水晶石。这些石头在和平时期是秩序和权威的象征，在冲突时期是强大力量的武器。

一侧，是使用这些石头的圣骑士。另一方面，为了摧毁这些石头而在世界各地寻找的紫发少女。这个故事从双方相遇时开始。


[轻微翻译/改编自[url=http://kimikakesou.sakura.ne.jp/topb.htm]开发者网站[/url]。]
